answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond whose slashing schedule is tuned as reconnection current sheet, so a sudden gale of duplicate registrations collapses into a hollow of forfeited stake rather than a stable ledge of fake reputation. Validators cross-check bonded identities against correlated submission timing and shared funding graphs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
